title: lex.json — PayrollEngine Compliance Source Manifest
description: Source manifest documenting the provenance of compliance values in a data regulation satellite.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI for IDE validation

regulation.description: Regulation identifier — typically the Data satellite name (e.g. Data.Tax, Data.Rates)

provider.description: Issuing authority or data provider (e.g. Tax authority)

languages.description: Languages of the sources (ISO 639-1 or 639-3 codes) for the number and year words of LexVerifySource; each needs a language file {code}.json in the package or the additional language folder. Without languages all available languages apply.

sources.description: Document-level source references — general provenance for the entire manifest

values.description: Compliance values with content and precise provenance

files.description: Source documents to copy into the .lex folder

exclusions.description: Documented exclusions from the coverage, sourceLocation, orphan and automatic verification rules, derived properties and properties not applicable of entries. Excluded items are listed in the check report.

kind.description: coverage: regulation values without lex entry. sourceLocation: lex entries without sourceLocation. orphan: lex entries without regulation value (evidence of a rule implemented in code). autoVerification: lex entries verified manually only (LexVerifySource writes no source location and no automatic verification record). derived: property of a lex entry that is derived from other values and is not in the source (LexVerifySource does not look up its numbers). notApplicable: property of a lex entry with the value 0 because the rule does not apply (a zero property without this exclusion is reported).

pattern.description: Key pattern: Lookup, Lookup.Key, or a prefix with trailing '*'. A name also matches all keys below it. derived and notApplicable: entry key and property path of the JSON content (Lookup.Key.Property, nested properties separated by '.').

reason.description: Mandatory justification for the exclusion; derived: formula and legal reference; notApplicable: why the rule does not apply

url.description: URL to the source document or page

legalBasis.description: Legal basis (e.g. Income Tax Act §12, Act 123/2025 Art. 4)

review.description: Review rule for the values of this source (values whose sourceUrls list the source url). FourEyes: manual verifications require reviewedBy and reviewedOn.

official.description: Official source of the issuing authority. false: secondary source (e.g. a commercial summary); it may be a further source of a value, but not the main source (first URL of sourceUrls).

mode.description: auto: verified by a tool against the source. manual: verified by a person with an evidence document.

verifiedBy.description: Person who verified the value (manual mode only)

evidence.description: Evidence document declared in the files[] array (mandatory in manual mode)

method.description: Tool and version that verified the value (auto mode only)

reviewedBy.description: Second person who confirmed a manual verification (sources with review FourEyes)

reviewedOn.description: Review date in YYYY-MM-DD format (sources with review FourEyes)

derived.description: Properties of the value that are derived from other values and not taken from the source (auto mode only, see exclusion kind derived)

key.description: Unique value identifier within this manifest

content.description: Inline compliance value — scalar, JSON object, or JSON array. Mutually exclusive with contentFile.

contentFile.description: Relative path to a source file to copy into the .lex folder, or a file inside a ZIP archive written as '<archive>!<entry>' (e.g. 'tariffs.zip!tariff-a.txt'); the archive must be declared in files[] and is not extracted. Without contentMap the file must be JSON. Mutually exclusive with content.

contentMap.description: Text table map (JSON, relative to the .lex folder) that converts the text file of contentFile into the values of the whole lookup (LexApply). The map holds key or keys, an optional rangeValue, value or values and optional filters. Only together with contentFile.

documentRef.description: Reference to a local evidence document declared in the files[] array (e.g. 'tax-rates-2026.pdf'). The referenced fileName must exist in files[].

sourceUrls.description: URLs where this specific value can be found. A value combined from several authorities lists one URL per authority; the first one is the main source.

sourceLocation.description: Precise location within the source document (free text). Examples: 'Calculation guide 2026, Page 12, Section 3.2.1', 'Income Tax Act §12(1) sentence 2', 'File tariff-a.txt'

sourceQuote.description: Verbatim quote from the source that holds the value. LexVerifySource anchors the numbers of the value that the quote holds and looks up the other numbers in all sources; a quote without a number of the value locates the section that must hold the numbers. Numbers in words within the quote count (e.g. 'one and one-half times').

referenceYear.description: Year the value belongs to legally when it differs from the cycle of the manifest (e.g. a surcharge for 2025 in the 2026 satellite). Replaces the validFrom year in the year context of LexVerifySource and for the year of the sourceQuote; LexCheck lists entries with another year as information.

open.description: Open entry: value taken from the previous cycle by LexRollover, needs a new verification. A new verification record removes the flag.

fileName.description: Target file name in the .lex folder

sourcePath.description: Local path to the source file (copied into .lex by LexSnapshot)

sourceUrls.description: Source URLs — when sourcePath is empty, LexSnapshot downloads the file from the first URL that answers
